title: Eurycoma longifolia tincture for medicinal use
intro: Eurycoma longifolia tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made from the roots of the Eurycoma longifolia plant, commonly known as Tongkat Ali. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian herbal medicine for its purported effects on energy, vitality, and sexual health. The tincture is typically prepared by soaking the dried roots in alcohol to extract their active compounds. It is often used to support physical performance, reduce stress, and enhance libido in both men and women. Due to its potency, it is usually taken in small doses and is considered a powerful adaptogen in herbalism.
